answer: Resist sybils with randomized adversarial audits. The network plants honeypots - flawed answers, invalid transactions - randomly assigned to graders and attesters. Vouching for planted junk costs your stake and your seat; catching it pays a bounty. An attacker fields a murder of ravens, but each faces the falcon problem: every approval dives at prey that may be bait, and each junk approval risks ejection - loss scales with identities times attempts. Honest verification makes the network an oasis: trust stays cheap because cheating is randomly expensive.
